exceptions.justification: ReDoS in extglob matching; affects every published version (<= 4.0.7, no patched release exists). Reached only through dev tooling (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, eslint-config-next), which only matches globs from this repository's own config. `npm audit --omit=dev` reports 0 vulnerabilities, so nothing ships to production or runs on user input.
